title: Templates
intro: Quizzes the hosts of this instance have offered as templates. Taking one puts an independent copy in your bank — yours to rename, cut and present. Nothing is pushed back to you afterwards.
empty: No template has been offered on this instance yet. Offer one from a quiz marked “ready”.
takeFailed: Could not take a copy of this template.

withdrawConfirm.title: Withdraw this template?
withdrawConfirm.description: It leaves the catalogue, so nobody takes it again. The copies people already took are theirs and are not touched.

shareConfirm.title: Offer this quiz as a template?
shareConfirm.description: A copy goes to this instance’s catalogue. Other hosts take their own copy and change it as they please; your quiz is never modified by what they do. Offering it again later replaces the entry, and withdrawing it never removes the copies already taken.

shareFailed: Could not offer this quiz as a template.
notFound: This template is no longer in the catalogue.
takeNeedsHost: Creating a quiz from a template is a host action.
unreadable: This template cannot be read whole: a copy would be refused ({{where}}).

community.title: Community quizzes
community.intro: Quizzes published by other authors. Check the source, licence and answers before taking an independent copy.
community.unavailable: Some sources could not be loaded. Try again later.
